name: ability_calls
sql: CREATE TABLE ability_calls(operation TEXT NOT NULL,key_digest TEXT NOT NULL,request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,receipt_json TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(operation,key_digest))

name: approvals
sql: CREATE TABLE approvals(approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(execution_id),scope TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_digest TEXT NOT NULL,invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_ref TEXT NOT NULL,nonce TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(consumed IN (0,1)),UNIQUE(issuer_ref,nonce))

name: audit
sql: CREATE TABLE audit(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,execution_id TEXT,phase TEXT NOT NULL)

name: execution_control
sql: CREATE TABLE execution_control(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('active','paused')),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=0))

name: execution_control_events
sql: CREATE TABLE execution_control_events(revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,mode TEXT NOT NULL,actor_ref TEXT NOT NULL,changed_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: executions
sql: CREATE TABLE executions(execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope TEXT NOT NULL, purchase_ref TEXT NOT NULL, request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, intent_json TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT, snapshot_digest TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('awaiting_authorization','ready','executing','reconciliation_required','succeeded','closed')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, claimed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(claimed IN (0,1)), invocation_id TEXT, closed_reason TEXT, receipt_json TEXT, UNIQUE(scope,purchase_ref), CHECK(claimed=0 OR state NOT IN ('ready','awaiting_authorization')))

name: incidents
sql: CREATE TABLE incidents(execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(execution_id),evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL,code TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(execution_id,evidence_id,digest,code))

name: issued_approvals
sql: CREATE TABLE issued_approvals(approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES approvals(approval_id),approval_json TEXT NOT NULL)

name: observations
sql: CREATE TABLE observations(execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(execution_id),evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL,observation_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(execution_id,evidence_id))

name: payments_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE payments_meta(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(version=1))

name: preparations
sql: CREATE TABLE preparations(execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES executions(execution_id),prepared_ref TEXT NOT NULL,provider_id TEXT NOT NULL)

name: provider_authorizations
sql: CREATE TABLE provider_authorizations(execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES executions(execution_id),started INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(started=1))

name: request_keys
sql: CREATE TABLE request_keys(scope TEXT NOT NULL,key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,execution_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES executions(execution_id),PRIMARY KEY(scope,key_hash))

name: restore_quarantine
sql: CREATE TABLE restore_quarantine(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),source_digest TEXT NOT NULL,restored_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: immutable_snapshot
sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_snapshot BEFORE UPDATE OF snapshot_json,snapshot_digest ON executions WHEN OLD.snapshot_json IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.snapshot_json IS NOT OLD.snapshot_json OR NEW.snapshot_digest IS NOT OLD.snapshot_digest) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_snapshot'); END

name: immutable_terminal
sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_terminal BEFORE UPDATE OF state,receipt_json ON executions WHEN OLD.state IN ('succeeded','closed') AND (NEW.state!=OLD.state OR NEW.receipt_json IS NOT OLD.receipt_json) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_terminal'); END

name: permanent_claim
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF claimed ON executions WHEN OLD.claimed=1 AND NEW.claimed!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_claim'); END

name: permanent_control_events_DELETE
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_control_events_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON execution_control_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_control_events'); END

name: permanent_control_events_UPDATE
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_control_events_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON execution_control_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_control_events'); END

name: permanent_execution
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_execution BEFORE DELETE ON executions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_execution'); END

name: permanent_execution_control
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_execution_control BEFORE DELETE ON execution_control BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_execution_control'); END

name: permanent_restore_marker_delete
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_restore_marker_delete BEFORE DELETE ON restore_quarantine BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_restore_quarantine'); END

name: permanent_restore_marker_update
sql: CREATE TRIGGER permanent_restore_marker_update BEFORE UPDATE ON restore_quarantine BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'permanent_restore_quarantine'); END

name: quarantine_claim
sql: CREATE TRIGGER quarantine_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF claimed ON executions WHEN OLD.claimed=0 AND NEW.claimed=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM restore_quarantine) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'restore_observation_only'); END

name: quarantine_native_authorization
sql: CREATE TRIGGER quarantine_native_authorization BEFORE INSERT ON provider_authorizations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM restore_quarantine) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'restore_observation_only'); END

name: quarantine_resume
sql: CREATE TRIGGER quarantine_resume BEFORE UPDATE OF mode ON execution_control WHEN NEW.mode='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM restore_quarantine) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'restore_observation_only'); END

name: stopped_claim
sql: CREATE TRIGGER stopped_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF claimed ON executions WHEN OLD.claimed=0 AND NEW.claimed=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_control WHERE id=1 AND mode='active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'execution_paused'); END

name: stopped_native_authorization
sql: CREATE TRIGGER stopped_native_authorization BEFORE INSERT ON provider_authorizations WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_control WHERE id=1 AND mode='active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'execution_paused'); END
